info.name: Pure activity fundingOpportunity API
fundingOpportunity
Lists all funding opportunities

params.name: size
params.description: Number of returned funding opportunities per request.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset for the returned list. 0 or null value is from the start

params.name: order
params.description: The order of the list, must be a value from /fundingOpportunities/orderings

items.docs: Lists all funding opportunities in the Pure instance. If you need to filter the funding opportunities returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

info.name: Query operation for funding opportunities

items.docs: Lists funding opportunities in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.
